name: DDCoin Marketplace sellItem pays the seller twice
summary: Marketplace.sellItem pays the seller and also approves it for the same USDT amount, so a seller can pull each payout twice. An owner setInviteRadio call that put an address into the invite ratio gave inviters unbounded sell credit; the attacker listed through helpers it invited, sold DD into the queued buy orders and pulled every payout again.
notes: Reset: setInviteRadio(0x180d…, 20000e18) wrote an address into inviteRadio[0]; replaying the anchor with the original 200/100 ratios reverts 'Insufficient credit limit'. Three later setInviteRadio calls only swapped one address-sized ratio for another.

Loss is the Marketplace's gross USDT depletion net of the attacker's own listItem deposits. Without the broken credit limit the attacker could not fill the buy orders at all, so the first payouts count as well; buyers got DD worth a fraction of it at the pair price.
